style: short-premium decay on levered / inverse / vol ETFs

constraints.note: Separate sleeve, its OWN risk budget. Structural decay (vol drag + contango) across vol / nat-gas / crude / precious-metals / levered-index / single-stock ETFs. Signals are evaluated INTRADAY, not just EOD — a decay setup (e.g. VIX spiking to 55 then closing near 30) can vanish by the close. Tail is a vol spike, so DEFINED-RISK structures only; the systemic-stress veto still flattens it.
